themes.title: UAE AI peak: Altman praise, MGX IPO win, Dubai labs
themes.summary: Dubai Future Week 2026 is the backdrop for a strong regional AI day: OpenAI's CEO publicly crowns the UAE the world's most forward-looking AI adopter, Abu Dhabi's MGX emerges as a structural winner in Anthropic's record IPO, and Dubai institutions (Future Foundation, MBZUAI, GDRFA, Dubai Chambers) roll out research pacts, AI labs and assistant programmes. The UAE is converting AI ambition into institutions and balance-sheet exposure at the same time.
themes.angle: Gulf capital and policy are now core parts of the AI trade - and its risks.

themes.title: Nvidia legal crisis widens: criminal probe, SEC, China links
themes.summary: Nvidia's legal exposure deepened: California's probe into alleged illegal chip sales to China now covers potential criminal violations of state law, the SEC is separately investigating accounting, and FT reporting puts China's state security apparatus at the centre of the affair after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. For buyers, this is now a supply-chain and compliance risk as much as a governance story.
themes.angle: The AI darling's crisis is a procurement risk for every GPU buyer.

themes.title: AI trade breaks: bear market, Anthropic IPO fails to rally
themes.summary: US tech stocks plunged into a bear market in the worst week since Covid-19 as Anthropic and Nvidia shares tumbled on AI-capex fears and systematic-fund selling. Anthropic's record-setting IPO failed to reverse deteriorating sentiment, and Taiwan widened short-sale curbs after its benchmark's worst weekly fall in 35 years. The AI supercycle is being repriced in real time.
themes.angle: First bear market of the AI capex supercycle - the ROI question is finally being priced.

themes.title: Compute geopolitics: DC tax, China token rules, Decart deal
themes.summary: Compute infrastructure is now contested terrain: the US president threatens a 'tremendous' tax on data centres built outside the US, China's data administration moves to standardise AI token measurement and billing, and Amazon is closing on a $7.5bn acquisition of Decart to help AWS compete with Nvidia on compute. Supply chains, token economics and data-centre siting are all being politicised at once.
themes.angle: Token measurement is becoming a state standards war - inference economics is now policy.

themes.title: AI cyber consolidation: CrowdStrike-Zscaler, agentic threats
themes.summary: A wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers is reshaping cybersecurity as vendors race to defend against AI-powered attacks - CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler. Meanwhile agentic AI is prompting new privacy and resilience questions: Signal blocked AI agents from reading chats via screenshots, and commentators (FT, NYT) argue AI-driven outages and attacks are only beginning.
themes.angle: If cyber vendors consolidate around AI, CISOs' negotiating power shifts - watch contractual leverage.
